notes: Every list on the site goes through this component. Items render through Text atom. Icon variant uses Icon atom for decorative markers. No animation. Pipeline strips icon prop in textonly (native bullets replace). Textonly render: native disc/decimal bullets, icons hidden, inline collapses to vertical. Colour comes from the global .color--{name} mixin (colour.css).

contentList.description: Array of items. Pipeline content key. Each item is either a string (plain text) or { contentLink, href } (linked item).

icon.description: Phosphor icon slug for simple icon markers. Stripped in textonly. Ignored if media is set.

media._description: Rich marker atom — overrides the default bullet/icon/dot markers. Each list item renders its own instance.
Nested atom node. Child atom owns its own props (colour, size, animation, background). Shape can wrap an Icon. LottieIcon excluded — use an animated Icon instead.

text._description: Text atom styling props forwarded to each item's Text atom.

textStyle._description: Validated against Text.schema.json. List controls 'as' and 'flush' internally.

colour._description: Brand-scale colour for markers. Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor.

brandColor.description: Brand-scale colour for markers, icons, dots. 'text' = body text scale (always readable).

rainbow._description: Rainbow palette colour (1-7 positional) for markers.

as.description: HTML element override. ul=unordered, ol=ordered. Auto-resolves from variant if omitted.

variant.description: List style. default=bullets, numbered=ordered numbers, none=no markers, inline=horizontal, dot=custom circles.

markerSize.description: Marker size for dots, icons, numbers, and media markers. Uses --media-* em tokens.
